name: Six Senses AMAALA
insider_take: Six Senses AMAALA is where ultra-luxury meets transformative wellness on one of the world's most pristine coastlines — a destination so exclusive, it's still being written into existence.
whats_special: Nestled within the visionary AMAALA mega-project on Saudi Arabia's northwestern Red Sea coast, Six Senses AMAALA is a sanctuary designed around the trilogy of wellness, art, and the sea. The resort sits within Triple Bay, a sweeping stretch of coral-rich coastline boasting some of the most biodiverse marine ecosystems on the planet — with over 1,000 species of fish and 300 species of coral thriving in its waters. As part of IHG's prestigious Destination by IHG collection, this property redefines Arabian luxury with biophilic architecture that blends seamlessly into the dramatic desert-meets-sea landscape.
pro_tip: Book a Six Senses ALCHEMY BAR session early — these personalized wellness and holistic therapy workshops fill up fast and are truly one of a kind. Also, plan your arrival between October and April for the most ideal Red Sea diving and snorkeling conditions.
dont_miss: Don't miss the chance to explore the Red Sea's extraordinary underwater world, rated among the top dive destinations globally. AMAALA's commitment to being a 100% renewable energy-powered destination makes every stay guilt-free. Also, keep an eye out for the resident art installations and rotating cultural exhibitions that connect guests to the soul of the Arabian Peninsula.
pros: World-class wellness and spa programming rooted in Six Senses' signature holistic philosophy
Pristine Red Sea beachfront setting with stunning coral reef access and crystal-clear waters
Ultra-luxury villa accommodations with private pools and breathtaking sea views
Exceptional sustainability initiatives and eco-conscious design integrated throughout the resort
Curated culinary experiences showcasing locally inspired cuisine alongside international fine dining
cons: Remote destination requiring long-haul travel for most international guests
Ultra-premium pricing places this resort in the highest luxury tier
Limited nearby off-resort attractions given the secluded coastal location
